evidence: Yale New Haven Hospital added about $19.7M with higher admissions and paid per admit.
Wellstar MCG showed about +$80.6K paid per admit.
Emory Saint Joseph's added admissions with higher paid per admit.

Key DRGs include craniotomy and chemotherapy episodes.

MO EPO and IN POS growth was led by craniotomy.

Tracheostomy without major O.R. procedures spiked at WELLSTAR MCG in GA.
CO craniotomy cases rose with benign meningeal neoplasm and cerebral aneurysm diagnoses.
PA-required acute hospital IP Med/Surg claims show low-baseline, repeated outlier concentration.
peer_benchmarking: Centene broadly unbundles routine and integral facility services; useful benchmark for itemized bill review.
United Health bundles routine inpatient hospital services; benchmark routine-service payment validation on catastrophic claims.
